children.title: Contributor Guide
children.name: contributor-guide
children.prompt: Progressive guide for a new contributor fluent in Python or JavaScript. Part I: TypeScript via tsx, Prisma with SQLite/libsql, Vitest, Playwright, linkedom. Part II: the unified pipeline, the part kinds (collector, parser, resolver, handler, service, tool, util, view, orchestrator), the data model. Part III: setup, tests, fakes, rules in .claude/rules/. Sources: package.json, prisma/schema.prisma, lib/orchestrators/job-search.ts, .claude/rules/part-ownership.md, .claude/rules/naming.md, vitest.config.ts.

children.title: Staff Engineer Guide
children.name: staff-engineer-guide
children.prompt: Dense architectural guide. Core insight candidate: every step reads its own work out of the database by phase-gate flags and ends with a database write, so no step holds a list in memory between steps. Pseudocode in a different language (Python or Go). Tradeoffs: two-command scoring, read-only dashboard, data-not-code for site knowledge, trace table instead of a run table. Sources: lib/orchestrators/job-search.ts, lib/orchestrators/scoring.ts, lib/handlers/*.ts, lib/services/job-service.ts, lib/utils/job-merge.ts, docs/DECISIONS.md.

children.title: Executive Guide
children.name: executive-guide
children.prompt: Capability map, risk assessment, paid outside services and their cost model (.env.example), scaling limits (single SQLite file, one visible browser, map lookups one per second), recommendations. No code.

children.title: Product Manager Guide
children.name: product-manager-guide
children.prompt: User journeys: run a job search, score the backlog, review the dashboard, mark a job applied and file the Texas work log, write a resume. Feature map, known limits, what data is stored and where, FAQ. No engineering jargon. Sources: .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, docs/APP.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md.

children.title: Overview
children.name: overview
children.prompt: What the project is and why: a personal CLI job search assistant driven by Claude Code skills. The four jobs it does: find, rank, track, file the unemployment work log. Sources: CLAUDE.md, docs/APP.md, docs/architecture.md, package.json, lib/orchestrators/job-search.ts.
